title: Dumbbell curl
camera: Side view of the working arm, figure facing right

poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Stand tall with the dumbbell at your side, arm long and palm facing your thigh.

poses.label: Lift
poses.description: Curl it up with your elbow pinned to your side, turning your palm up as you lift.

poses.label: Top
poses.description: Squeeze at the top with your palm up and wrist straight. Your elbow stays at your side.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower it slowly, turning your palm back towards your thigh, all the way to a long arm.

checks: Upper arm stays vertical, pinned to the side, through the lift; it drifts at most 6 degrees forward at the top.
Wrist stays straight, in line with the forearm, in every pose.
Torso stays upright (0 degrees) in every pose: no swinging.
Elbow bends from about 4 degrees (a long arm, not locked) to about 136 at the top, short of the shoulder.
Palm faces the thigh at the bottom and turns up as the weight rises, matching the app's written cue.
Lowering returns to the long-arm setup under control (the loop eases in and out).
limitations: Visual guidance from a simplified figure, not an anatomical reference.
Shows one arm from the side; the written cue covers doing both sides.
The reference pages were checked through search summaries; their full text could not be opened from the build environment.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js; no third-party images or generated frames.
